apostilleStatus.note: Hague Apostille Convention membership decides whether a public document takes an apostille or needs consular legalisation. The full table is a separate file so it can be updated on its own as states accede.
apostilleStatus.lookup: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in countries[].code; apostilleMember is the answer for today, inForceFrom is the date the Convention entered into force for that state.
apostilleStatus.coverage: All 130 Contracting Parties, plus the non-parties named in Ra Legal guides. A country absent from the file is not known to be a non-party: check the HCCH status table before answering.
